{{Quote|We've lost all his vital signs. He is no longer functioning.|The droid after Bolla Ropal died|<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref>}}
This '''B1 battle droid''' was on board [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Cad Bane's ''Munificent''-class star frigate]], and worked on the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and interrogation of the [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]]. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Bane]] ordered the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to continue to be tortured after he refused to unlock a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], but this [[Death/Legends|killed]] Ropal. This [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] controlled the interrogation levels, and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] viewed the Jedi's vital signs. This [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] had a much deeper voice than other B1 battle droids.
